mode.description:
outline traverses objects and nested definitions; resolve-block finds
candidates for the current editing context along an explicit occurrence path.

options.description:
outline accepts ids or path, otherwise scope (selected/viewport/document),
depth and output budgets. field_groups is a nonempty list of summary, objects,
annotations and transforms; the default is a compact summary. include_geometry
and annotations explicitly request their details. Narrow IDs/path/depth after
truncation; max_items also bounds eligible visits (reason=max_visits).
resolve-block accepts only path: 1..65 GUIDs from the top-level instance inward.

expected_model_path.description: Usually omitted; the runtime supplies the bound document path.

include_ids.description: Include IDs when needed; supplied target IDs are not repeated.

plate_bounds_mm.description:
Floor plate [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] in mm
(sets gross area and the diagonal used for exit separation).

exits.description:
One entry per exit (stair door or exterior exit door):
{"name": str, "x_mm": float, "y_mm": float, "width_mm": float}.
Positions are the door centers; width is the clear egress width.

occupancy.description:
Occupant-load key: business, mercantile, assembly_
unconcentrated, classroom, residential, storage.

stories.description:
Stories served. Above 1, at least two exits are required
and exit width demand uses the stair factor (7.6 mm/occupant)
instead of the door factor (5.1).

sprinklered.description:
Sprinklered throughout (affects separation fraction,
travel-distance and dead-end limits).

net_area_m2.description: Override the occupied area; 0 uses the gross plate area.

travel_distances_m.description:
Measured worst-case travel distances (e.g. from
drawn egress paths); empty skips the travel check.

dead_end_m.description: Longest dead-end corridor in metres; 0 skips the check.

code.description: Synchronous Python 3 source; assign a JSON-safe value to result.

timeout_seconds.description: Integer 1-600, default 60; waiting limit, not execution cancellation.

script.description: Synchronous Python source, C# statement body or complete command macro.

language.description: python (default Python 3), python2, csharp, csharp-script or command; every mode uses official RhinoCode.

timeout_seconds.description: Integer 1-600, default 60; waiting limit only. Retrieve the same request after timeout.

guids.description: Rhino object GUIDs to export (from execute_rhino_script).

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to include (default 50, max 500).

span_m.description:
If > 0, each returned system reports fits_span and
suggested member depths from its span-ratio rules.

include_reference_data.description:
Also return occupancy live loads (kPa) and
material densities (kg/m3) for choosing load_kn inputs.

target_ids.description: Optional nonempty string array of object, group or Holon IDs. Duplicate resolved objects are selected once.

target_kind.description: object (default), group, block (ordinary object IDs), or holon; this selects the ID namespace, not allowed geometry types.

isolate.description: False by default. True invokes actual Rhino Isolate before Zoom Selected; use Unisolate to restore visibility.

scale_percent.description: 1..100, default 75; changes image resolution, not viewport window size.

include_usage.description: Include dimensions and an illustrative pixel-token estimate, not measured usage.

display_mode.description: Optional installed raster mode name/ID; changes the live model viewport when supplied.

labels.description: Optional transient labels; default false. The selection highlight remains Rhino's normal display.

expected_model_path.description: Usually omitted; runtime supplies the bound model.

target.description: Existing name or ID; case-insensitive name matches must be unique.

scale_percent.description: 1..100, default 75. Desired upper bound; percentage captures may shrink to fit the delivery budget.

include_usage.description: Include actual dimensions and an illustrative pixel-based token estimate, not measured usage.

display_mode.description: Installed mode name/ID for Named Views; empty uses Shaded. Layouts reject overrides.

labels.description: Optional transient entity labels; default false.

expected_model_path.description: Usually omitted; runtime supplies the bound model.

logic_id.description:
The filename (without extension) of the Grasshopper file.
      Use list_library() first to see available IDs.
      Examples: catenary, bending, 01_simplebeam

sections.description: Optional section names; omitted requests document, named_views, layouts and display_modes.

include_ids.description: Include identities outside the always-identified Named View/Layout/Display Mode catalogues.

include_editor_details.description: Include provider/command/Undo evidence only when editor is requested.

construction_system.description:
Filter to entries related to a construction
library system_id (e.g. "steel-column-frame").

audited_only.description: When true, list only capsules that run_gh_definition will accept.

guids.description: Rhino object GUIDs to export. Unrelated document objects are excluded.

asset_id.description:
Stable optional ID for linked updates. Generated deterministically
      from the Rhino document and GUIDs when omitted.

body_type.description:
"static" for architecture, "dynamic" for loose props, or
       "kinematic" for script-driven objects.

collider.description:
Collider intent: "box", "convex", "compound", or "trimesh".
      Chestnut currently falls back to a box where needed.

preserve_scale.description:
Keep Rhino's real-world dimensions instead of normalizing
            the model to a one-metre display prop.

mass.description: Physics mass in kilograms. Static bodies always use zero.

guids.description: Rhino object GUIDs returned by execute_rhino_script.

behavior.description:
Optional semantic preset:
"auto"         — infer architecture versus movable object from name
"architecture" — fixed building, terrain, structure, or enclosure
"object"       — movable physical prop affected by gravity
"animated"     — script-driven door, lift, platform, or mechanism

asset_id.description: Optional stable link ID. Omit for a deterministic Rhino link.

inputs.description: Object mapping ALMOND_IN_* port names to values (forms above).

seed.description: Optional integer seed for stochastic definitions; omit for deterministic ones.

anyOf.description: Add/remove string values; omission and empty arrays leave that operation empty.
Add/remove string values; omission and empty arrays leave that operation empty.
Add/remove string values; omission and empty arrays leave that operation empty.
Add/remove string values; omission and empty arrays leave that operation empty.

guids.description: Current Rhino object GUID strings in the analysis scope.

structure_type.description:
Analysis template to use. Options:
"beam"       — simple beam bending/deflection
"truss"      — axial force/buckling analysis
"shell"      — shell stress/displacement
"frame"      — moment/shear frame analysis
"canopy"     — cantilevered canopy
"gridshell"  — large deformation gridshell
"membrane"   — form-finding membrane
"highrise"   — high-rise structural systems

fixed_supports.description: True = fully fixed supports, False = pinned (rotations free).

span_m.description:
structural span in meters for the L/250 limit when members are split at
every node (e.g. a 6.2 m joist drawn as two 3.1 m segments). Native engine only.

asset_loads.description:
add the gravity loads of placed library assets (estimated self weight
plus in-use contents/occupants from each asset's load entry, e.g. a filled
bathtub) where they stand on (or hang from) the frame. Placements come from
Rhino objects tagged with an Almond asset id, or from the scene ledger when
scene_id is given. Native engine only; the result's "asset_loads" lists every
placement with its load and carrying members, or why it was not applied.

floor_load_kn_m2.description:
imposed floor load in kN/m2 (e.g. 2.0 for homes, EN 1991-1-1
category A) on every bay enclosed by beams on a level; the beams take it by the
45-degree rule (two-way, one-way above 2:1). Native engine only. A code floor load
already covers movable furniture and people: combine it with asset_loads only for
heavy specific items, and set load_kn to 0 to avoid double counting.

floor_dead_kn_m2.description:
superimposed dead load in kN/m2 (floor build-up, finishes) on the
same bays.

design_basis.description:
"en1990" (default): deflection at SLS characteristic (G + Q), member
checks at ULS 1.35 G + 1.5 Q. G = self weight, floor build-up and the weight of
placed items; Q = load_kn, the occupancy floor load, contents and occupants.
"unfactored" checks both at G + Q (the Karamba route's basis). Native engine.

uls_combination.description:
"6.10" or "6.10ab" (the worse of 6.10a and 6.10b per member). Default:
the design code's choice (Eurocode profile: 6.10). A profile that prescribes one
expression overrides the request (with a warning).

connections.description:
"rigid" (default: every joint transmits moment) or "simple": beams are
pinned (major-axis bending released) and braces pinned in both axes where they
stop - not where another member carries on in line - while columns stay
continuous. Typical bolted steel and timber framing is closer to "simple"; rigid
joints can flatter beam deflection. A curve's user text almond:release = "pinned" |
"pinned_start" | "pinned_end" | "rigid" overrides either mode. Native engine.

stability.description:
"auto" (default): elastic critical load factor alpha_cr for every ULS
combination (EN 1993-1-1 5.2.1) and sway imperfections phi = 1/200 x alpha_h x alpha_m
(5.3.2) in +/-x and +/-y; alpha_cr < 10 runs a second-order (P-Delta) ULS analysis,
alpha_cr <= 1 fails as unstable. "off": first-order without imperfections.

design_code.description:
design code profile for the numbers a code or National Annex sets
(gamma_G, gamma_Q, psi_0, xi, gamma_M0, gamma_M1, deflection limit): "eurocode"
(default, EN recommended values), any profile from list_design_codes, or "off"
(unfactored G + Q, no partial factors; same as design_basis="unfactored").
Results carry "design_code" with the values used and any unverified ones.

detail.description:
native engine only. Adds "members" (per member: role, length, section, ULS design
forces N/V/M/T, governing combination and check, slenderness, chi, stress,
utilization, SLS deflection and span/deflection ratio, pinned ends) and "supports"
(reactions Fx..Mz at SLS and each ULS combination). Off by default to keep replies short.

fabrication.description:
hollow steel sections (CHS/RHS) are "cold_formed" (default, EN 10219,
buckling curve c) or "hot_finished" (EN 10210, curve a; a0 for S460). The difference
is up to about 23 % in buckling resistance; use hot_finished only when specified.

guids.description:
Curve GUIDs of the structural axes plus point GUIDs marking supports
(see fixed_supports). Without points, the lowest nodes are supported.

load_kn.description: Total imposed load in kN, shared equally by the free nodes (-Z).

fixed_supports.description: True = fully fixed supports, False = pinned (rotations free).

deflection_limit_ratio.description:
span/ratio limit, e.g. 250 for L/250. Default: the design code's
limit (Eurocode profile: 250).

span_m.description:
reference span in meters for the limit (default: longest member).
Set it when members are split at every node, e.g. a 6.2 m joist drawn
as two 3.1 m segments.

scale.description: deformation exaggeration; omit for automatic (~6% of span).

reveal.description: 0..1 fraction of members drawn (for staged construction playback).

reanalyze.description:
False re-uses the last solve and only changes the display
(scale / color_by / reveal / physics / title) - cheap enough to animate.

physics.description:
False draws the same members as plain geometry with no analysis
overlay ("physics off"), for before/after comparisons.

display_guids.description:
draw only these members (e.g. one frame line for a section
view); the analysis still covers every member in guids.

engine.description:
"auto" (default: Almond's native frame solver, no Karamba needed; Karamba
when the selection has shells or the bridge cannot export a model),
"native" or "karamba".

asset_loads.description:
add the loads of placed library assets (native engine), as in
validate_structure; loaded points are drawn with load arrows.

connections.description:
"rigid" or "simple", as in validate_structure; pinned ends are drawn
as small circles.

view.description:
"deflection" (default) or "buckling": draw the first buckling mode of the
governing ULS combination with its alpha_cr (STABLE >= 10, SWAY-SENSITIVE 1-10,
UNSTABLE <= 1) instead of the deflected shape.
